# PRD: task-phases — Phase-aware status model for codexu roadmap dashboard

*Generated by `/implement-with-ralph` Phase 2 PRD subagent on 2026-05-17. Source: `.ralph/jobs/task-phases/plan.md` + `stories-outline.md`. Autonomous mode — no clarifying questions asked; assumptions are documented inline.*

## Introduction / Overview

Today the codexu bookkeeping convention tracks one row per task in `plans/overview.html` and `plans/parallel-assignments.md`, with a single status badge (`b-ready` / `b-blocked` / `b-paused` / `b-closed` / `b-inprogress`) collapsing three distinct operator actions (brainstorm / plan / implement) plus three different intermediate review-pause states. From the dashboard it is impossible to tell whether a "ready" task has a plan landed but unreviewed, a plan approved but implementation not started, or no plan at all — they all collapse to `b-ready`.

This PRD introduces a **phase-aware status model** as an HTML-only change surface. Every `<details class="cmd">` row carries an explicit `data-task-phase` (one of 10 enum values) plus a separate cross-cutting `data-task-status` modifier (`ok | blocked | paused`). CSS phase badges and JS classifiers / filters / Today-panel logic read from these attributes, with legacy `.b-*` classes preserved as fail-soft aliases. This is plan #1 of three sibling plans; `overview-data-split.md` (plan #2) and `overview-vite-react.md` (plan #3) are explicitly blocked on this landing first.

## Goals

- Introduce a 10-value phase enum (`brainstorm-ready | brainstorm-in-progress | brainstorm-review | plan-ready | plan-in-progress | plan-review | impl-ready | impl-in-progress | shipped | closed`) and a 3-value status modifier (`ok | blocked | paused`) expressed as `data-task-phase` / `data-task-status` attributes on every command row.
- Add 10 new `.cmd-badge.b-<phase>` CSS classes plus a `.cmd-status-mod` modifier class, with dark/light theme parity, defined once near the existing badge block at `plans/overview.html:845-849`.
- Update JS classifiers (`classifyAndOrderCmds`, `classifyCmd`, the multi-axis filter, Today-panel grouping) to read attributes as the source of truth, with legacy-class fail-soft fallback.
- Migrate all 49 existing command rows + every kanban card per the pinned Migration Mapping table in `plan.md` lines 154-218.
- Reconcile known drift on `perf-WS3` and `1a-fork-doc` between `overview.html` and `parallel-assignments.md`.
- Update bookkeeper docs (`plans/parallel-assignments.md` front-matter + per-task table; `plans/codexu-roadmap.md` Standing rules; `.agents/skills/roadmap-and-overview/SKILL.md`) to describe the new model on day one.
- Smoke-test all 4 progression paths (brainstorm / standard / fused 1-paragraph / planOnly) on a temporary copy of `overview.html`.

## User Stories

### US-001: CSS + JS plumbing for phase + status schema
**Description:** As a roadmap viewer and bookkeeper, I want the dashboard CSS and JS to read a new `data-task-phase` + `data-task-status` model (with all 10 phase classes defined, JS consumers reading from the attributes, and legacy `.b-*` classes preserved as fail-soft aliases), so the migration in US-002 can land without breaking section ordering, the Today panel, filter chips, or the kanban summary.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 10 new `.cmd-badge.b-<phase>` CSS classes defined in `plans/overview.html` near the existing badge block at lines `845-849`, with non-transparent computed backgrounds in both dark (`:root` `7-21`) and light (`@media prefers-color-scheme: light` `22-38`) themes; no two phases in the same phase family resolve to the identical color. Class-definition grep: `grep -cE '\.cmd-badge\.b-(brainstorm-ready|brainstorm-in-progress|brainstorm-review|plan-ready|plan-in-progress|plan-review|impl-ready|impl-in-progress|shipped|closed)' plans/overview.html` returns at least 10.
- [ ] `.cmd-status-mod` modifier sub-badge class defined (`grep -cE '\.cmd-status-mod' plans/overview.html` >= 1).
- [ ] `PHASE_TO_ORDER_BUCKET` constant introduced near the top of the existing `<script>` block, with `shipped` and `closed` in distinct buckets (per commit `b2598368`).
- [ ] `PHASE_TO_FILTER_BUCKET` constant introduced (sibling), with `shipped` and `closed` collapsed into the `closed` bucket.
- [ ] `classifyAndOrderCmds()` at `2671-2695` reads `data-task-phase` via `PHASE_TO_ORDER_BUCKET`, falling back to the legacy class mapping when the attribute is absent.
- [ ] `classifyCmd()` at `2842-2851`, the multi-axis filter at `3126-3163`, and any Today-panel bucket logic at `962` read `data-task-status` first (status precedence: `blocked` and `paused` override phase) then `data-task-phase` via `PHASE_TO_FILTER_BUCKET`, falling back to legacy class mapping when both attributes are absent.
- [ ] New `renderPhaseBadges()` IIFE added near `2626` that walks every `<details class="cmd">[data-task-phase]`, normalizes the inline `.cmd-badge` class to `cmd-badge b-<data-task-phase>`, and inserts/removes a `<span class="cmd-status-mod">` sibling based on `data-task-status`. Rows with only a legacy `b-*` class (no `data-task-phase`) get `data-task-phase` derived from the inverse of `PHASE_TO_FILTER_BUCKET` and normalized in the same pass. Wrapped in per-row `try {} catch {}`; failures logged to `console.warn` with the row's `data-task-id`.
- [ ] `injectTaskScopeChips()` at `2626-2668` updated to capture both `.cmd-badge` and `.cmd-status-mod` before building `.cmd-scope-cluster`, then append both into the cluster (badge first, modifier last so it sits to the right).
- [ ] `renderPhaseBadges()` invoked before `injectTaskScopeChips()` in the IIFE chain.
- [ ] No change required to `populateKanbanCount` at `2953-2965` (it counts cards per existing column only — verify).
- [ ] Both existing brittle title-text matchers refactored to read `card.dataset.taskId` instead of substring-matching `title.textContent`: workstream-tagging at `3293-3307` and `linkKanbanToCmds` (`→ command` link injection) at `3334-3355`.
- [ ] Legacy `.b-ready`, `.b-blocked`, `.b-paused`, `.b-closed`, `.b-inprogress` classes remain defined and styled (fail-soft aliases). A hand-crafted test row with only `<span class="cmd-badge b-ready">` (no `data-task-phase`) renders visually identical to today and classifies into the `ready` bucket.
- [ ] No console errors when loading `plans/overview.html` in a browser.
- [ ] Verify in browser using dev-browser skill (load overview.html, toggle dark/light, confirm no visual regression).
- [ ] Typecheck passes (project has no automated typecheck for `plans/*.html`; acceptance is "no JS console errors on load and the DevTools assertion snippet in US-002 returns zero failures once US-002 lands").

## Functional Requirements

- FR-1: Every `<details class="cmd">` row in `plans/overview.html` MUST carry `data-task-phase` (one of 10 enum values) and `data-task-status` (one of `ok | blocked | paused`).
- FR-2: The primary visible badge inside each `<details class="cmd">` MUST be `.cmd-badge.b-<data-task-phase>`, rendered at load time by the new `renderPhaseBadges()` IIFE (not hand-maintained).
- FR-3: When `data-task-status !== "ok"`, a `<span class="cmd-status-mod">` sub-badge MUST be rendered alongside the primary phase badge, inside the `.cmd-scope-cluster` wrapper.
- FR-4: `classifyAndOrderCmds()` MUST read `data-task-phase` via `PHASE_TO_ORDER_BUCKET` (with `shipped` and `closed` in distinct buckets, preserving the commit-`b2598368` behavior).
- FR-5: `classifyCmd()`, the multi-axis filter, and the Today-panel bucket logic MUST read `data-task-status` first (status precedence) then `data-task-phase` via `PHASE_TO_FILTER_BUCKET` (with `shipped` collapsed into `closed`).
- FR-6: All four JS consumers MUST fall back to the legacy `.b-*` class mapping when both attributes are absent, so a future hand-written row using only legacy classes still renders and classifies correctly.
- FR-7: Every kanban card MUST carry `data-task-id` matching a command row; both existing brittle title-text matchers (workstream tagging at `3293-3307` and `linkKanbanToCmds` at `3334-3355`) MUST be refactored to consume `card.dataset.taskId`.
- FR-8: Legacy `.b-ready`, `.b-blocked`, `.b-paused`, `.b-closed`, `.b-inprogress` CSS classes MUST remain defined as fail-soft aliases (DO NOT remove).
- FR-9: Both dark (`:root` block at `7-21`) and light (`@media prefers-color-scheme: light` at `22-38`) themes MUST render all 10 phase classes with non-transparent computed backgrounds; no two phases in the same family (brainstorm / plan / impl) resolve to the identical color.
- FR-10: `plans/parallel-assignments.md`, `plans/codexu-roadmap.md`, and `.agents/skills/roadmap-and-overview/SKILL.md` MUST be updated per US-004's acceptance criteria.

## Non-Goals (Out of Scope)

- Extracting task data out of HTML into a sidecar JSON/JS file — that is `overview-data-split.md` (plan #2).
- Rewriting the viewer as Vite + React — that is `overview-vite-react.md` (plan #3).
- Any inline-edit affordance to change phase from the UI — earliest is `overview-vite-react.md` Stage 6.5.
- Auto-bumping `lastTouchedAt` in `roadmap-data` JSON when phase changes — bookkeeper bumps manually.
- New kanban columns — preserve the 3-column structure (`Ready` / `Soon` / `Blocked`); phase becomes a pill on each card.
- Adding a `Phase` filter chip to the toolbar at `978-985` (the existing `Status` chips stay as-is; phase becomes filterable in v1 only via deep-linking / text search). Adding a phase axis is a follow-up.
- Auto-populating `data-*-job-id` artifact attributes from filesystem state — bookkeeper populates manually after each operator action.
- Auto-deriving `phase === "plan-review"` from the existence of `.ralph/jobs/<task-id>/plan.md` — operator-asserted only.
- Touching `.ralph/jobs/*/plan.md` files (per-task PRDs).
- Touching the existing roadmap phase tree at `1895+` (workstream phases, different concept).
- Adding `phaseTreePath` (plan #2's field).
- A `Phase | Modifier | Plan source/job | Commit` super-detailed status table format in `parallel-assignments.md` — keep it to `Phase | Status | Plan source | Plan job` as the v1 schema.

## Design Considerations

- **Two-layer model.** Data attributes are the authoritative source; CSS badge classes are derived render artifacts written by `renderPhaseBadges()` on page load. This eliminates the dual-write drift risk (F-008) from the original plan.
- **Color palette per phase family.** Reuse existing semantic CSS vars: brainstorm-phase → `--purple` (3 intensities via opacity), plan-phase → `--info` / `--accent`, impl-phase → `--warn`, `shipped` → `--ok`, `closed` → `--done`. Status modifier: `--warn` for `blocked`, `--muted` for `paused`.
- **Precedence rule (status modifier vs phase).** For filter / Today-panel / kanban-bucket assignment, `data-task-status` takes precedence (blocked/paused override phase). For sort/order in `classifyAndOrderCmds()`, phase only — status never affects sort order. Documented as a code comment above the `PHASE_TO_ORDER_BUCKET` / `PHASE_TO_FILTER_BUCKET` constants and at the top of each consumer function.
- **PRD style references:** `tasks/prd-1a-fork-doc.md`, `tasks/prd-port-explorer-prompt.md` (autonomous + operator-gated stories pattern).

## Technical Considerations

- **HTML-only change surface.** No build step, no Vite, no React, no sidecar JSON. All edits live in `plans/overview.html`, `plans/parallel-assignments.md`, `plans/codexu-roadmap.md`, and `.agents/skills/roadmap-and-overview/SKILL.md`.
- **Backwards-compat for legacy `b-*` classes.** Future hand-edited rows that use only `b-ready` / `b-blocked` / `b-paused` / `b-closed` / `b-inprogress` (no `data-task-phase`) MUST render readably. `renderPhaseBadges()` derives `data-task-phase` from the legacy class on load (inverse of `PHASE_TO_FILTER_BUCKET`).
- **Dark/light theme parity.** Light theme `@media` defines the same token set as dark; reuse is safe but the brainstorm 3-intensities via opacity need visual QA in light mode.
- **Phase is operator-asserted.** Never inferred from filesystem state. The presence of `.ralph/jobs/<task-id>/plan.md` is NOT a reliable signal; operator judgment is required for `plan-review` vs `plan-ready`, and for `brainstorm-ready` vs `plan-ready`.
- **Sibling-plan enum lock-in.** `overview-data-split.md` and `overview-vite-react.md` reference this plan's enum verbatim. Field names locked: `phase`, `status`, `planSource`, `brainstormJobId`, `planJobId`, `implementJobId`, `mergeCommit`, `planReviewIterations`, `planOnly`, `brainstormPrompt`, `planPrompt`, `implementPrompt`.
- **No automated test infrastructure** for HTML/JS under `plans/`. Acceptance is grep-based + manual DevTools verification.
- **IIFE invocation order:** `renderPhaseBadges()` MUST run before `injectTaskScopeChips()` so the `.cmd-status-mod` sibling exists when the cluster is built.

- All 49 command rows carry valid `data-task-phase` + `data-task-status` (grep equality test: both counts == 49).
- Zero DevTools assertion failures on the badge-class consistency snippet from US-002.

- `perf-WS3` and `1a-fork-doc` drift reconciled (US-003).
- Sibling plans #2 and #3 can be picked up without needing to re-litigate the phase enum or field names.
